description: Defines a class for a database-backed key/value store with expiration capabilities in Drupal.

classes.name: DatabaseStorageExpirable
classes.description: A key/value store implementation that uses a database table with expiration support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the storage with collection name, serializer, database connection, time service, and table name.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists and has not expired.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple key-value pairs that have not expired.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all key-value pairs that have not expired.

methods.name: doSetWithExpire
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair with an expiration time.

methods.name: setWithExpire
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair with expiration, creating the table if necessary.

methods.name: doSetWithExpireIfNotExists
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair with expiration only if it does not already exist.

methods.name: setWithExpireIfNotExists
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair with expiration if it does not exist, creating the table if necessary.

methods.name: setMultipleWithExpire
methods.description: Sets multiple key-value pairs with the same expiration time.

methods.name: schemaDefinition
methods.description: Defines the database schema for the key-value store with expiration.
